title: Profile Change to < 100% ends in error „Basalwert wurde durch den kleinstmöglichen Wert ersetzt: Profilwechsel“
body:
In 3.2 Version we have no trouble to switch the profile to 80%.
Basal Values are still the same. I will send the log file via mail.

comments.body: I don't see any profile switch at this time

Basal rate can't be lower than 0,05. So I guess your profile contains a basal rate = 0,05, then you will see this error. You could try to set it to 0,07 and check what basal rate is sent to pump. Then you will be able to reduce it.

> Basal rate can't be lower than 0,05. So I guess your profile contains a basal rate = 0,05, then you will see this error. You could try to set it to 0,07 and check what basal rate is sent to pump. Then you will be able to reduce it.

Thanks for the hint. I had one basal with 0,05. I changed it to 0,06. After that i can do profile switches to 90%. issue can be closed.
sorry for bothering ;-)
